EMS Chief.rule: When an EMS Chief arrives on scene, all stabilized patients are automatically routed to the nearest hospital with available beds and the matching department.

EMS Chief + EMS MCV Dual Synergy.rule: Missions with >=25 patients require EMS Mobile Command Vehicle (6 crew, EMS Mobile Command training). If you assign 2 crew members trained in EMS Mobile Command directly into an EMS Chief, that single EMS Chief vehicle satisfies both the EMS Chief and the EMS MCV mission requirements simultaneously.

Police Supervisor / Sheriff Unit.rule: Automatically assigns detained suspects to available empty patrol units and routes them directly to open station holding cells.

Fly-Car ALS Upgrade.rule: A Fly-Car does not transport patients, but its presence on scene upgrades basic BLS Ambulances into full ALS Ambulances, enabling them to treat critical patient codes.

Manpower Speed Multiplier.rule: Incident duration scales inversely with on-scene personnel. A Type 1 Engine with 6 firefighters clears fires twice as fast as one with 3 firefighters. Use Crew Carriers (12 crew) to dump raw personnel on large brush fires to accelerate completion.
Manpower Speed Multiplier.example: Type 1 Engine 6 crew = 2x speed of 3 crew

Equipment Capacity Points.rule: Each vehicle has an equipment load limit (e.g., Quint: 30, Type 1 Engine: 20, Patrol Car: 20). Equipping portable items allows standard vehicles to fulfill niche call requirements without buying dedicated apparatus.
